resources.string: On your Lectern, open Settings → Devices and show a pairing QR code: either \"Pair a phone over the relay\" (end-to-end encrypted, works from anywhere) or \"Pair a phone\" (direct). Scan it here, or paste its link. You can also paste your Lectern\'s address if this phone reaches it over Tailscale.
That is not a Lectern pairing link or address.
This link pairs with %1$s. Check it is yours, then tap Connect.
Tap to open. Hold to rename or remove. Notifications say which Lectern they came from.
This phone forgets the pairing, its key and its notifications. The Lectern keeps its own record of this device until you revoke it in Settings → Devices.
Updating needs “Allow from this source” for Lectern in Android settings.
Pair this app with a Lectern first.
Sharing images needs a direct pairing, not a relay.
